SEBI Chairman: Existing Exchange Infrastructure Adequate, Location-Based Exchanges Difficult

Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated that the existing exchange infrastructure is sufficient to handle larger trading volumes. He also indicated that operating location-based exchanges would be difficult at present. Pandey added that SEBI is working to make capital markets more accessible, efficient, and resilient.
